Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom, within thumb reach, on accounts that show it at the top. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Mueve la barra de pestañas de Facebook abajo, al alcance del pulgar, en las cuentas que la muestran arriba. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the search row is the top bar with the Facebook logo, search and Messenger
Moves Facebook's tab bar to the top, under the search row, as older Facebook had it. Restart Facebook to see the change.

column2: Ocultar la barra de pestañas al desplazarte

The bottom tab bar hides as you scroll down and returns when you scroll up, for more room. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: La barra de pestañas inferior se oculta al bajar y vuelve al subir, para tener más espacio. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, after Hide the tab bar while scrolling; the bottom bar never slides off the screen

column2: Mantener la barra de pestañas en pantalla

column1: # context: description of that switch; it greys out while Hide the tab bar while scrolling is on
The bottom tab bar stays put while you scroll, on accounts where Facebook slides it away. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: La barra de pestañas inferior se queda fija al desplazarte, en las cuentas donde Facebook la oculta. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column2: Mantener la barra superior en pantalla

column2: La barra superior con la búsqueda y Messenger se queda fija al bajar, en vez de ocultarse.

column2: Diseño de móvil en pantallas grandes

column1: # context: description of that switch; on a big screen Facebook keeps the tab bar at the top in a wider layout, so the tab bar switches above it do nothing there

A tablet or an unfolded phone gets the layout Facebook uses on a phone, so the tab bar choices above work on the big screen too. Facebook's wider big screen layout goes away. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a big screen yet. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Una tablet o un móvil plegable abierto recibe el diseño que Facebook usa en un móvil, así los ajustes de la barra de pestañas de arriba también funcionan en la pantalla grande. Desaparece el diseño más ancho de Facebook para pantallas grandes. Apagado por defecto, porque aún no se ha probado en una pantalla grande. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, after Phone layout on big screens; it makes Facebook's top bar (search and Messenger) and its tab bar partly transparent
See-through bars
column2: Barras transparentes

column1: # context: description of that switch; the feed is the list of posts on Home, and blurred means frosted like glass
The top bar and the tab bar turn see-through, so the feed shows through them as you scroll. On Android 12 and newer the feed behind them is blurred.
column2: La barra superior y la barra de pestañas se vuelven transparentes, así el feed se ve a través de ellas mientras te desplazas. En Android 12 y versiones posteriores, el feed que queda detrás se ve difuminado.

column2: Forzar modo oscuro

column1: # context: description of that switch; on some tablets Facebook's own Settings page has no Dark mode row
Keeps Facebook dark no matter its own setting. Meant for tablets where Facebook has no Dark mode switch. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Mantiene Facebook oscuro sin importar su propio ajuste. Pensado para tabletas en las que Facebook no tiene el interruptor de modo oscuro. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column2: Tarjetas negras

column1: # context: description of that switch; a card is a raised panel such as a post or the Menu's profile box, near black is the dark gray the theme gives it

Cards and menus take the page's own color instead of the near black that sets them apart. Buttons and search fields keep a dark gray fill, so you can still see them. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Las tarjetas y los menús toman el color de la página en lugar del negro casi puro que los distingue. Los botones y los campos de búsqueda mantienen un relleno gris oscuro para que sigas viéndolos. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column2: Una línea gris fina entre las publicaciones del feed, para que las publicaciones sin fotos no se mezclen sobre la página negra.

column1: %1$s becomes the date and time of the save, %2$s the video's number on Facebook, %3$s who posted it, %4$s their profile's number on Facebook and %5$s the day it was posted. What a save doesn't know is left out, and a name with none of these gets the date added. When the name is already in the folder, the time of the save goes on the end. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to use the default, %6$s.
column2: %1$s se convierte en la fecha y la hora del guardado, %2$s en el número del video en Facebook, %3$s en quien lo publicó, %4$s en el número de su perfil en Facebook y %5$s en el día en que se publicó. Lo que el guardado no sabe se omite, y a un nombre sin ninguno de ellos se le añade la fecha. Si el nombre ya está en la carpeta, se le añade al final la hora del guardado. Los caracteres no válidos se convierten en guiones bajos. Déjalo vacío para usar el nombre predeterminado, %6$s.

column2: Eventos

column1: Notifications
column2: Notificaciones

column1: Menu
column2: Menú

column1: # context: summary of the tab list; %1$s is one of the tab names above
Facebook opens on %1$s. If your tab bar doesn't have it, Facebook opens on Home.
column2: Facebook se abre en %1$s. Si tu barra de pestañas no la tiene, Facebook se abre en Inicio.

column1: # context: summary of the tab list when Feeds is picked; off the tab bar, Feeds opens as its own page over Home
Facebook opens on Feeds. If your tab bar doesn't have it, the Feeds page opens over Home.
column2: Facebook se abre en Feeds. Si tu barra de pestañas no la tiene, la página de Feeds se abre sobre Inicio.

column1: # context: a sentence in the settings import preview and its toast; %1$s is a tab name
Facebook will open on %1$s.
column2: Facebook se abrirá en %1$s.

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook; Following is Facebook's feed of the friends, Pages and groups you follow, and Home is the tab
Following feed on Home
column2: Feed Siguiendo en Inicio

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the ranked feed is the one Facebook orders for you, and the Feeds tab has its own filters
Home shows the newest posts from friends, groups and Pages you follow, like All in the Feeds tab, or the filter you pick below. The Feeds tab's filters don't change.
column2: Inicio muestra las publicaciones más recientes de los amigos, grupos y páginas que sigues, como Todo en la pestaña Feeds o el filtro que elijas abajo. Los filtros de la pestaña Feeds no cambian.

column1: Jump to a section
column2: Ir a una sección

column1: Go straight to one group of settings. Back returns to where you were.
column2: Ve directo a un grupo de ajustes. Atrás te devuelve a donde estabas.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; on, every video save keeps to formats other apps accept
Save videos other apps can open
column2: Guardar videos que otras apps puedan abrir

column1: # context: summary of that switch; WhatsApp is a name and stays as it is, and saves are the videos the user saved to the phone
Fixes saved videos that play without sound in WhatsApp, video editors such as CapCut and InShot, or some galleries and players. May lower quality.
column2: Arregla los vídeos guardados que se reproducen sin sonido en WhatsApp, editores de vídeo como CapCut e InShot, o algunas galerías y reproductores. Puede bajar la calidad.

column1: # context: title of a switch under Downloads; convert means re-encoding the video on the phone
Convert to keep the full size
column2: Convertir para mantener el tamaño completo

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Save videos other apps can open is the switch above it, VP9, AV1 and H.264 are video formats and stay as they are

With Save videos other apps can open on, a full size video Facebook only has as VP9 or AV1 is converted to H.264 on your phone instead of saved smaller. Slower, and videos over 10 minutes stay smaller.
column2: Con Guardar videos que otras apps puedan abrir activado, un video en tamaño completo que Facebook solo tiene en VP9 o AV1 se convierte a H.264 en tu teléfono en vez de guardarse más pequeño. Es más lento, y los videos de más de 10 minutos se guardan más pequeños.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; on, a save shows no message when it starts, finishes or is canceled
Quiet saves
column2: Guardar sin avisos

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a toast is Android's short message at the bottom of the screen
No toast when a save starts, finishes or is canceled. A save that fails still says why.
column2: Sin aviso cuando un guardado empieza, termina o se cancela. Si uno falla, se sigue mostrando el motivo.

column1: # context: section title for the Chats settings, named like Facebook's own Chats screen
Chats
column2: Chats

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; the card is Facebook's own "Get the Messenger app" card
Hide the Get Messenger card
column2: Ocultar la tarjeta para obtener Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Messenger is the app's name and stays as it is
Hides the card at the top of Chats that asks you to get Messenger, once Messenger is installed. Without Messenger, the card stays.
column2: Oculta la tarjeta de la parte superior de Chats que te pide instalar Messenger, cuando Messenger ya está instalado. Sin Messenger, la tarjeta se queda.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; the notes and active now row is the row of friends' notes and who's active above the chat list in Chats inside Facebook
Hide the notes and active now row
column2: Ocultar la fila de notas y activos

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Removes the row above your chats that shows friends' notes and who's active. Your own note tile may go too. Your chats stay.
column2: Quita la fila sobre tus chats que muestra las notas de tus amigos y quién está activo. Tu propia nota también puede desaparecer. Tus chats se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; promotions are the banners Facebook puts at the top of the chat list
Hide chat list promotions
column2: Ocultar promociones de la lista de chats

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides the banners at the top of Chats, like the one asking you to turn on notifications.
column2: Oculta los avisos de la parte superior de Chats, como el que te pide activar las notificaciones.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name; the button sits beside the search box at the top of Chats and on Chats' search screen
Hide the Meta AI button in Chats
column2: Ocultar el botón de Meta AI en Chats

column1: # context: summary of that switch; your chats with Meta AI are conversations with the assistant, which stay in the list
Removes the Meta AI button beside the search box in Chats, at the top of the list and on the search screen. The search box stays, and so do your chats with Meta AI.
column2: Quita el botón de Meta AI junto al cuadro de búsqueda en Chats, arriba de la lista y en la pantalla de búsqueda. El cuadro de búsqueda se queda, y tus chats con Meta AI también.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; on, Facebook's Messenger icon opens the Messenger app
Open the Messenger app
column2: Abrir la app de Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Messenger is the app's name, Chats is Facebook's own chat screen as named above
Tapping the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook opens the Messenger app instead of Chats. Without Messenger, Chats opens as before.
column2: Al tocar el icono de Messenger en la parte superior de Facebook, se abre la app Messenger en lugar de Chats. Sin Messenger, Chats se abre como antes.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; on, Facebook leaves ringing for calls and notifying about chats to the Messenger app
Leave calls and chats to Messenger
column2: Dejar llamadas y chats a Messenger

column1: # context: summary of that switch; signed out means not logged in to the Messenger app, turned off means the app is disabled in Android's settings

Facebook leaves calls and chat notifications to Messenger while Messenger is installed and enabled. Restart Facebook after changing this switch, or after installing, removing, enabling or disabling Messenger, so call routing updates. If you're signed out of Messenger, you'll miss calls and messages.
column2: Facebook deja las llamadas y las notificaciones de chat a Messenger mientras Messenger esté instalado y activado. Reinicia Facebook después de cambiar este interruptor o de instalar, eliminar, activar o desactivar Messenger para actualizar el enrutamiento de llamadas. Si cerraste sesión en Messenger, te perderás llamadas y mensajes.

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Tap to play switch
Playback
column2: Reproducción

column1: # context: switch title; on, videos and music wait for a tap before they play
Tap to play
column2: Toca para reproducir

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Autoplay and Off are the name and value of Facebook's own setting, as Facebook shows them in this language
Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of playing by themselves. Facebook's own Autoplay setting shows Off while this is on.
column2: Los vídeos, reels, historias y la música esperan a que los toques, en lugar de reproducirse solos. El ajuste Reproducción automática de Facebook muestra Desactivado mientras esto está activo.

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook; Marketplace is Facebook's tab and keeps its name
Marketplace only
column2: Solo Marketplace

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook, next to Marketplace only; Events is Facebook's tab and keeps its name
Events only
column2: Solo Eventos

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the tab names are Facebook's own, as its tab bar shows them
# context: switch title under Menu; Upgrades is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Upgrades
column2: Ocultar “Mejoras”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Settings and Help and support are Facebook's own Menu sections
The Upgrades section and its offers leave Facebook's Menu. Settings, Help and support and the rest of the Menu stay.
column2: La sección “Mejoras” y sus ofertas desaparecen del menú de Facebook. Configuración, Ayuda y soporte técnico y el resto del menú se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Also from Meta is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Also from Meta
column2: Ocultar “También de Meta”

column1: Hide the Muse card
column2: Ocultar la tarjeta de Muse

column1: The Muse card, Meta's ad for its AI agent app, leaves the top of Facebook's Menu.
column2: La tarjeta de Muse, el anuncio de Meta para su app de agente de IA, desaparece de la parte superior del menú de Facebook.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the section links to Meta's other apps and shows ads for its devices
The Also from Meta section leaves Facebook's Menu, with its links to Meta's other apps and its ads for Meta's devices. Your own shortcuts stay.
column2: La sección “También de Meta” desaparece del menú de Facebook, con sus enlaces a las otras apps de Meta y sus anuncios de dispositivos de Meta. Tus propios accesos directos se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Help and support is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Help and support
column2: Ocultar “Ayuda y soporte técnico”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Settings and privacy is Facebook's own Menu section
The Help and support section leaves Facebook's Menu, header and all. Settings and privacy stays.
column2: La sección “Ayuda y soporte técnico” desaparece del menú de Facebook, con su encabezado. “Configuración y privacidad” se queda.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Settings and privacy is a section of Facebook's own Menu that folds and unfolds when its header is tapped
Keep Settings and privacy expanded
column2: Mantener abierta “Configuración y privacidad”

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu stays open, so its rows show without a tap.
column2: “Configuración y privacidad” se queda abierta en el menú de Facebook, así sus filas se ven sin tocar nada.

column1: # context: section title for the search settings, named like Facebook's own search
Search
column2: Búsqueda

column1: # context: switch title under Search; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name
Hide Meta AI in search
column2: Ocultar Meta AI en la búsqueda

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Meta AI and Ask Meta AI are Meta's own names, as Facebook shows them
Search no longer shows Meta AI answers or Ask Meta AI prompts, or sends your search to Meta AI. Results for people, groups, pages and posts stay.
column2: La búsqueda ya no muestra respuestas de Meta AI ni avisos de Ask Meta AI, ni envía tu búsqueda a Meta AI. Los resultados de personas, grupos, páginas y publicaciones se quedan.

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Default comment order switch and its list
# context: switch title; on, a post's comments open in the order chosen in the list below it
Default comment order
column2: Orden predeterminado de los comentarios

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a link to a comment is one from a notification, say
Use the order below. A choice made on a post lasts until restart. Links to comments keep Facebook's order.
column2: Usa el orden de abajo. El elegido en una publicación dura hasta reiniciar. Los enlaces a comentarios conservan el orden de Facebook.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; Meta AI writes a short summary of what a post's comments say
Hide Meta AI comment summaries
column2: Ocultar los resúmenes de comentarios de Meta AI

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the buttons are a post's Like, Comment and Share row
Hides Meta AI's summary at the top of comments and the comment summary under a post's buttons. The comments themselves stay.
column2: Oculta el resumen de Meta AI en la parte superior de los comentarios y el resumen de comentarios bajo los botones de una publicación. Los comentarios en sí se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; the few comments Facebook shows under a post in the feed, below its Like, Comment and Share row
Hide comments under posts
column2: Ocultar los comentarios bajo las publicaciones

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Comment is the post's Comment button
Feed posts stop showing a few comments under their buttons. Tap Comment to read them all.
column2: Las publicaciones del feed dejan de mostrar comentarios bajo sus botones. Toca Comentar para leerlos todos.

column1: Hide dislike on comments
column2: Ocultar el pulgar abajo en los comentarios

column1: Takes the thumbs-down off comments. Like and Reply stay.
column2: Quita el pulgar hacia abajo de los comentarios. Me gusta y Responder se quedan.

column1: Hide Like on comments
column2: Ocultar Me gusta en los comentarios

column1: Takes Like off the row under comments. Reply and the reaction count stay.
column2: Quita Me gusta de la fila bajo los comentarios. Responder y el número de reacciones se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; Like is the button under a post or a comment
Like only
column2: Solo Me gusta

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the reactions are the row of Love, Haha, Wow and the rest that a long press on Like opens
A long press on Like doesn't open the reactions. A tap still likes.
column2: Mantener pulsado Me gusta ya no abre las reacciones. Un toque sigue dando Me gusta.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; GIF and sticker are two buttons in the box where you type a comment
Hide GIF and sticker buttons
column2: Ocultar los botones de GIF y stickers

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the comment box is where you type a comment
The comment box loses its GIF and sticker buttons. Typing, photos and posting work as before.
column2: El cuadro de comentarios pierde sus botones de GIF y stickers. Escribir, añadir fotos y publicar funcionan como antes.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments: hides the Add a comment field at the bottom of the full-screen video viewer
Hide the video comment box
column2: Ocultar el cuadro de comentarios de los videos

column1: The Add a comment box under a full-screen video goes away. Comment boxes on posts stay.
column2: Desaparece el cuadro para comentar debajo de un video en pantalla completa. Los cuadros de comentarios de las publicaciones se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; a reply thread is the replies under a comment, which Facebook folds behind View replies
Open every reply thread
column2: Abrir todos los hilos de respuestas

column1: # context: summary of that switch; View replies is the link Facebook shows under a comment that has replies
Comments show their replies right away, so there's no View replies to tap.
column2: Los comentarios muestran sus respuestas al instante, sin tener que tocar Ver respuestas.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; it makes an open reply thread load the rest of its replies by itself as the list is scrolled
Load whole reply threads
column2: Cargar hilos de respuestas completos

column1: # context: summary of that switch; View more replies is the row Facebook shows under an open thread that has more replies to load
An open reply thread keeps loading as you scroll, so there's no View more replies to tap.
column2: Un hilo de respuestas abierto sigue cargando mientras te desplazas, sin tener que tocar para ver más respuestas.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; View more replies is the row under an open reply thread that loads more replies, and this makes the whole row take the tap instead of only its words
Tap anywhere on View more replies
column2: Tocar en cualquier parte de Ver más respuestas

column1: # context: summary of that switch
The whole View more replies row opens the replies, not just its words.
column2: Toda la fila Ver más respuestas abre las respuestas, no solo su texto.

column1: Hide related groups
column2: Ocultar grupos relacionados

column1: A group post's comments end without the Related groups list and its Join buttons.
column2: Los comentarios de una publicación de grupo terminan sin la lista Grupos relacionados ni sus botones Unirse.

column1: # context: row title under Comments that opens Facebook's own settings; reaction counts are the numbers next to the reactions on a post
Hide reaction counts
column2: Ocultar el número de reacciones

column1: # context: summary of that row; Preferences and Reaction preferences are the names Facebook's own settings use
Facebook has its own setting for this. Open Facebook's settings, then Preferences and Reaction preferences.
column2: Facebook tiene su propio ajuste para esto. Abre la configuración de Facebook y luego Preferencias y Preferencias de reacciones.

column1: # context: message shown when Facebook's own settings could not be opened from that row
Facebook's settings didn't open. You'll find Reaction preferences in its Settings, under Preferences.
column2: La configuración de Facebook no se abrió. Encontrarás Preferencias de reacciones en su Configuración, dentro de Preferencias.

column1: # context: title of the list of comment orders, and of its dialog
Comment order
column2: Orden de los comentarios

column1: # context: entry of that list: the order Facebook's servers pick, which is what happens without Hushfacebook
Facebook's choice
column2: Lo que elija Facebook

column1: # context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
Most relevant
column2: Más relevantes

column1: # context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
Newest
column2: Más recientes

column1: # context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
All comments
column2: Todos los comentarios

column1: # context: summary of the list when Facebook's choice is picked; Most relevant is Facebook's own name for that order
Comments open in the order Facebook picks, which is usually Most relevant.
column2: Los comentarios se abren en el orden que elige Facebook, que suele ser Más relevantes.

column1: # context: summary of the list; %1$s is one of the order names above, as Facebook's sort menu shows it
A post's comments open with %1$s picked in their sort menu, where the post offers it.
column2: Los comentarios de una publicación se abren con %1$s elegido en su menú de orden, si la publicación lo ofrece.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that sets the comment order to Facebook's choice
Comments will open in the order Facebook picks.
column2: Los comentarios se abrirán en el orden que elija Facebook.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that sets the comment order; %1$s is one of the order names above
Comments will open with %1$s picked in their sort menu.
column2: Los comentarios se abrirán con %1$s elegido en su menú de orden.

column1: # context: switch title under Search; the ads Facebook puts between search results
Hide sponsored search results
column2: Ocultar resultados de búsqueda publicitarios

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides ads between your search results. The results you searched for stay.
column2: Oculta los anuncios entre los resultados de tu búsqueda. Los resultados que buscaste se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the ads between the posts on a person's profile or a Page
Hide sponsored profile posts
column2: Ocultar publicaciones publicitarias en perfiles

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Page is Facebook's name for a business or public figure's page
Hides ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page. Their own posts stay.
column2: Oculta los anuncios entre las publicaciones del perfil de alguien o de una página. Sus propias publicaciones se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; a note is the short text bubble (or a 'Drop a thought' prompt) Facebook shows over a person's profile picture
Hide profile notes
column2: Ocultar notas del perfil

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides the note bubble that sits on profile pictures. Applies the next time you open a profile.
column2: Oculta la burbuja de nota que aparece sobre las fotos de perfil. Se aplica la próxima vez que abras un perfil.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Save is Facebook's own button that keeps a post in your saved items
Save button under posts
column2: Botón Guardar debajo de las publicaciones

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Like, Comment and Share are the buttons under a post
Adds Facebook's own Save button next to Like, Comment and Share under posts. A saved post shows its bookmark filled in.
column2: Añade el botón Guardar de Facebook junto a Me gusta, Comentar y Compartir debajo de las publicaciones. Una publicación guardada muestra su marcador relleno.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; a button that saves a post's video or photos to the phone
Download button under posts
column2: Botón Descargar debajo de las publicaciones

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Downloads is the name of Hushfacebook's settings page for saving media
Adds a Download button under posts with a video or photos. It saves the video, the photo, or every photo of an album, using the Downloads settings.
column2: Añade un botón Descargar debajo de las publicaciones con un video o fotos. Guarda el video, la foto o todas las fotos de un álbum con los ajustes de Descargas.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Like is Facebook's own button under a post
Hide Like under posts
column2: Ocultar Me gusta debajo de las publicaciones

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Comment is Facebook's own button under a post
Hide Comment under posts
column2: Ocultar Comentar debajo de las publicaciones

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Share is Facebook's own button under a post
Hide Share under posts
column2: Ocultar Compartir debajo de las publicaciones

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Send is Facebook's own button under a post that sends it in a chat
Hide Send under posts
column2: Ocultar Enviar debajo de las publicaciones

column1: # context: summary shared by those four switches
Takes this button out of the row under posts in the feed. The other buttons stay, and a post with all of its buttons hidden shows no row.
column2: Quita este botón de la fila debajo de las publicaciones del feed. Los demás botones se quedan, y una publicación con todos sus botones ocultos no muestra la fila.

column1: # context: what stays in while Hushfacebook is paused, followed by the patch name in brackets; the row in Facebook's own Menu that opens Hushfacebook settings
# context: a short message when the Hushfacebook row in Facebook's Menu couldn't open the settings
Hushfacebook settings can't open here. Long-press the Facebook logo instead.
column2: La configuración de Hushfacebook no se puede abrir aquí. Mantén pulsado el logotipo de Facebook.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the row of groups Facebook suggests joining, shown between posts
Hide suggested groups
column2: Ocultar grupos sugeridos

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Discover more groups is the label of Facebook's own button under that row
Hides the row of groups to join between posts. Posts from groups you're in stay.
column2: Oculta la fila de grupos a los que unirte entre publicaciones. Las publicaciones de tus grupos se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Facebook's own header of a row of Stories from people you don't know, shown between posts
Hide "Stories you might like"
column2: Ocultar “Historias que te pueden gustar”

column1: Hide Memories in the feed
column2: Ocultar recuerdos en el feed

column1: Hide friend requests in the feed
column2: Ocultar solicitudes de amistad en el feed

column1: Hide friends' locations
column2: Ocultar ubicaciones de amigos

column1: # context: switch title under News feed, part of Hide suggested and promoted posts; a post opened by tapping a notification
Hide more posts under notification posts
column2: Ocultar más publicaciones bajo las publicaciones de notificaciones

column1: Hides Memories between posts, like "On this day" and friendship anniversaries. Your Memories page stays.
column2: Oculta los recuerdos entre publicaciones, como «Un día como hoy» y los aniversarios de amistad. Tu página de Recuerdos se queda.

column1: Hides friend requests shown between posts. Your requests stay under Friends.
column2: Oculta las solicitudes de amistad que aparecen entre publicaciones. Tus solicitudes se quedan en Amigos.

column1: Hides the card between posts that shows where your friends are.
column2: Oculta la tarjeta entre publicaciones que muestra dónde están tus amigos.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "More from your friends" is the heading Facebook shows over that list
A post you open from a notification ends without the "More from your friends" list Facebook adds under it, which can carry ads.
column2: Una publicación que abres desde una notificación termina sin la lista «Más de tus amigos» que Facebook añade debajo, que puede incluir anuncios.

column1: Hide the Find friends card
column2: Ocultar la tarjeta Buscar amigos

column1: Hides the "Want to see more posts from friends?" card with its Find friends button where your friends' posts run out.
column2: Oculta la tarjeta «¿Quieres ver más publicaciones de amigos?» con su botón Buscar amigos donde se acaban las publicaciones de tus amigos.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the Stories tray is the row of Stories at the top of the feed
Hides the row of Stories from people you aren't connected to, between posts. Your friends' Stories and the Stories tray stay.
column2: Oculta la fila de historias de personas con las que no tienes relación, entre publicaciones. Las historias de tus amigos y la bandeja de historias se quedan.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; trending videos Facebook sends as push notifications
Block trending video notifications
column2: Bloquear notificaciones de videos en tendencia

column1: # context: summary of that switch; reels are Facebook's short videos
Trending videos and the reels Facebook picked for you stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: Los videos en tendencia y los reels que Facebook eligió para ti dejan de aparecer en tus notificaciones.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; memories are Facebook's posts from past years on the same day
Block memory notifications
column2: Bloquear notificaciones de recuerdos

column1: # context: summary of that switch; On this day is the name Facebook gives its memories feature
Facebook's "On this day" memories stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: Los recuerdos de “Un día como hoy” de Facebook dejan de aparecer en tus notificaciones.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; reminders of friends' birthdays
Block birthday notifications
column2: Bloquear notificaciones de cumpleaños

column1: # context: summary of that switch
No more reminders that it's a friend's birthday.
column2: Se acabaron los avisos de que un amigo cumple años.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; Page is Facebook's name for a business or public figure's page
Block group and Page highlights
column2: Bloquear destacados de grupos y páginas

column1: # context: summary of that switch; creators are the people and Pages who post videos and posts you follow
Digests of what's going on in groups, Pages and creators you follow stop. Comments, replies and mentions still come through.
column2: Dejan de llegar los resúmenes de lo que pasa en los grupos, las páginas y los creadores que sigues. Los comentarios, las respuestas y las menciones siguen llegando.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; People you may know is Facebook's name for its friend suggestions, as in Hide "People you may know"
Block "People you may know"
column2: Bloquear “Personas que quizá conozcas”

column1: # context: summary of that switch; friend requests are other notifications, which always come through
Friend suggestions stop showing up in your notifications. Friend requests still come through.
column2: Las sugerencias de amistad dejan de aparecer en tus notificaciones. Las solicitudes de amistad siguen llegando.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; places near you and weather alerts Facebook sends
Block nearby and weather notifications

Alerts about places near you and about the weather stop.

column1: Block account setup reminders

column1: Reminders to finish setting up a Facebook account stop. Login and security alerts still come through.

Block group activity notifications
column2: Bloquear notificaciones de actividad en grupos

Notifications about new activity in your groups stop. Comments, replies and mentions in groups still come through.
column2: Dejan de llegar las notificaciones de actividad nueva en tus grupos. Los comentarios, las respuestas y las menciones en grupos siguen llegando.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; an event invite is someone inviting you to a Facebook event
Block event invites
column2: Bloquear invitaciones a eventos

Invites to events stop showing up in your notifications.

Block live video notifications
column2: Bloquear notificaciones de videos en vivo

Notifications that someone is live stop, including the ones you asked Facebook for.
column2: Dejan de llegar las notificaciones de que alguien está en vivo, incluidas las que le pediste a Facebook.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; reactions are likes and the other reaction buttons on posts and comments
Block reaction notifications
column2: Bloquear notificaciones de reacciones

Likes and reactions to your posts and comments stop showing up in your notifications. Comments still come through.

Quiet hours
column2: Horas de silencio

The switches above block their kinds only between the two times below. The rest of the day those kinds come through.
column2: Los interruptores de arriba bloquean sus tipos solo entre las dos horas de abajo. El resto del día esos tipos siguen llegando.

Quiet hours start

column1: # context: row title and list title; the time quiet hours finish

What always comes through

Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions, calls, login alerts and any kind not listed above always arrive. Android's notification settings for Facebook can block more.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Suggested is the label Facebook shows under such a story in the tray, and the tray reloads on its own schedule
Shows only friends and followed Pages in the Stories tray. Applies when Facebook next loads the tray.
column2: Muestra solo amigos y páginas que sigues en la bandeja de historias. Se aplica cuando Facebook cargue la bandeja de nuevo.

Hide sponsored Marketplace listings

Hides ads and boosted listings in Marketplace's feed and search results. Regular listings stay.
column2: Oculta los anuncios y los anuncios promocionados en el feed y la búsqueda de Marketplace. Los anuncios normales se quedan.

Hides posts containing a word or phrase from your list below. Words that keep a post win over it. Your words stay on this phone unless you export them.
column2: Oculta las publicaciones que contienen una palabra o frase de tu lista de abajo. Las palabras que conservan una publicación tienen prioridad. Tus palabras se quedan en este teléfono salvo que las exportes.

column1: # context: title of the row and dialog holding the list of words and phrases that hide a post
Words to hide
column2: Palabras para ocultar

column1: # context: title of the row and dialog holding the list of words and phrases that keep a post even when it has a word to hide
Words that keep a post
column2: Palabras que mantienen una publicación

column1: # context: message of the Words to hide dialog; %1$d is how many phrases a list holds (50), %2$d and %3$d the shortest and longest phrase in characters (2 and 60)

One word or phrase per line, up to %1$d lines, each %2$d to %3$d characters long. A single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough on its own. Capital letters don't matter, and a phrase matches anywhere in a post's text, even inside longer words.
column2: Una palabra o frase por línea, hasta %1$d líneas, de %2$d a %3$d caracteres cada una. Un solo emoji o carácter chino, japonés o coreano basta por sí solo. Las mayúsculas no importan, y una frase coincide en cualquier parte del texto de una publicación, incluso dentro de palabras más largas.

column1: # context: message of the Words that keep a post dialog; %1$d is how many phrases a list holds (50), %2$d and %3$d the shortest and longest phrase in characters (2 and 60)

A post with any of these stays, even when it also has a word to hide. One per line, up to %1$d lines, each %2$d to %3$d characters long. A single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough on its own.
column2: Una publicación con cualquiera de estas palabras se queda, aunque también tenga una palabra para ocultar. Una por línea, hasta %1$d líneas, de %2$d a %3$d caracteres cada una. Un solo emoji o carácter chino, japonés o coreano basta por sí solo.

One word or phrase per line

%1$d line was left out. A phrase needs %2$d to %3$d characters, but a single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough. One given twice counts once.
column2: Se omitió %1$d línea. Una frase necesita de %2$d a %3$d caracteres, pero basta un solo emoji o carácter chino, japonés o coreano. Una repetida cuenta una vez.

column1: # context: toast after saving a word list, several lines left out; %2$d and %3$d are the shortest and longest phrase in characters
%1$d lines were left out. A phrase needs %2$d to %3$d characters, but a single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough. One given twice counts once.
column2: Se omitieron %1$d líneas. Una frase necesita de %2$d a %3$d caracteres, pero basta un solo emoji o carácter chino, japonés o coreano. Una repetida cuenta una vez.

Both lists together would fill %1$d%% of the room they share. Remove or shorten some phrases, then save again.
column2: Las dos listas juntas ocuparían el %1$d %% del espacio que comparten. Quita o acorta algunas frases y vuelve a guardar.

Hid %1$d post since Facebook started.
column2: Se ocultó %1$d publicación desde que Facebook se inició.

Hid %1$d posts since Facebook started.

Writing

Tag suggestions only after @
column2: Sugerencias para etiquetar solo después de @

Type @ before Facebook suggests someone to tag in posts or comments. Your text stays unchanged.
column2: Escribe @ para que Facebook sugiera a quién etiquetar en publicaciones o comentarios. Tu texto no cambia.

Resume long videos
column2: Reanudar videos largos

Videos over two minutes pick up where you left off. Drag the bar to start elsewhere. Short reels, live videos and ads start as usual.
column2: Los vídeos de más de dos minutos continúan donde los dejaste. Arrastra la barra para empezar en otro punto. Los reels cortos, los vídeos en directo y los anuncios empiezan como siempre.

Frame step
column2: Avance por fotogramas

With a reel or video paused, tap its right side to step one frame forward and its left side to step one frame back. Tap the middle to play.
column2: Con un reel o vídeo en pausa, toca su lado derecho para avanzar un fotograma y su lado izquierdo para retroceder uno. Toca el centro para reproducirlo.

Also hide posts labeled as AI

column2: Ocultar Meta AI en el feed

column1: Hide AI character posts
column2: Ocultar publicaciones con personajes de IA

column2: Oculta las publicaciones con personajes de IA de Meta, los chatbots que la gente crea con Meta AI Studio. Apagado por defecto, porque aún no se ha probado en un feed real.

Turn off double tap to like
column2: Desactivar tocar dos veces para dar Me gusta

A double tap on a reel, a video or a photo in the feed no longer likes it or shows a heart. A single tap and the Like button work as before.
column2: Tocar dos veces un reel, un vídeo o una foto del feed ya no le da Me gusta ni muestra un corazón. Un toque y el botón Me gusta funcionan como antes.

Double tap to skip
column2: Tocar dos veces para saltar

A double tap on the left or right edge of a reel or video skips back or forward 10 seconds, or 5 on one under 30 seconds. A double tap in the middle works as before.
column2: Tocar dos veces el borde izquierdo o derecho de un reel o un vídeo retrocede o avanza 10 segundos, o 5 si dura menos de 30 segundos. Tocar dos veces en el centro funciona como antes.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; on, a tap on a playing reel shows its controls without pausing it
Tap shows the controls
column2: Tocar muestra los controles

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the button in the middle is the play and pause button in the reel's controls
A tap on a playing reel shows its controls while it keeps playing, and a second tap hides them. The button in the middle still pauses.
column2: Tocar un reel que se está reproduciendo muestra sus controles sin detenerlo, y un segundo toque los oculta. El botón del centro sigue pausándolo.

column1: Keep the reel speed
column2: Mantener la velocidad de los reels

column1: # context: summary of that switch
A playback speed you pick in a reel's menu stays for the next reels, after a restart too, until you pick another. Off, every reel starts at normal speed.
column2: La velocidad de reproducción que elijas en el menú de un reel se mantiene en los siguientes reels, también después de reiniciar, hasta que elijas otra. Desactivado, cada reel empieza a velocidad normal.

column1: Hold a reel for 2x
column2: Mantener pulsado un reel para 2x

column1: # context: summary of that switch; more button is the reel's own button with three dots
Holding a reel plays it at double speed until you let go, in place of Facebook's long-press menu. The reel's more button still opens that menu.
column2: Mantener pulsado un reel lo reproduce al doble de velocidad hasta que lo sueltes, en lugar de abrir el menú de pulsación larga de Facebook. El botón Más del reel sigue abriendo ese menú.

column1: # context: label of a switch under Hold a reel for 2x that keeps the hold to the reel's right edge
Only on the right edge
column2: Solo en el borde derecho

With the switch above on, only a hold on the right third of a reel plays it at double speed. Hold anywhere else and Facebook's long-press menu opens.
column2: Con el interruptor de arriba activado, solo mantener pulsado el tercio derecho de un reel lo reproduce al doble de velocidad. Si lo mantienes pulsado en otro sitio, se abre el menú de pulsación larga de Facebook.

column1: # context: label of a switch under Hold a reel for 2x; a feed video is a video playing in Home's feed or in Watch, not a reel
Hold a feed video for 2x
column2: Mantener pulsado un vídeo del feed para 2x

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Watch is Facebook's video tab, keep its name; the switches above are Hold a reel for 2x and Only on the right edge
Holding a video in the feed or in Watch plays it at double speed until you let go. It works without the switches above.
column2: Mantener pulsado un vídeo del feed o de Watch lo reproduce al doble de velocidad hasta que lo sueltes. Funciona sin los interruptores de arriba.

column1: Hide the pull down to lock hint
column2: Ocultar el aviso de deslizar hacia abajo para bloquear

Holding a video for 2x shows the plain 2x pill, without the "Pull down to lock 2x speed" hint. Pulling down still locks it. It works without the switches above.
column2: Al mantener pulsado un vídeo para 2x se muestra solo la etiqueta 2x, sin el aviso "Desliza hacia abajo para bloquear la velocidad 2x". Deslizar hacia abajo sigue bloqueándola. Funciona sin los interruptores de arriba.

Reels and videos go to the app below as a facebook.com link. Hold the reel Download button to copy the link instead. Stories still save to this phone.
column2: Los reels y videos van a la app de abajo como un enlace de facebook.com. Mantén pulsado el botón Descargar de un reel para copiar el enlace. Las historias se siguen guardando en este teléfono.

column1: # context: Summary of the download action row while saving, the default
Reels, videos and stories save to this phone.
column2: Los reels, videos e historias se guardan en este teléfono.

App to send to
column2: App de destino

column1: # context: Dialog message of the send-to app row; %1$s and %2$s are package names
The ID of the app that gets the links, such as %1$s for YTDLnis or %2$s for Seal. Leave it blank to pick an app each time.
column2: El ID de la app que recibe los enlaces, como %1$s para YTDLnis o %2$s para Seal. Déjalo en blanco para elegir una app cada vez.

column1: # context: Hint in the send-to app field
App ID
column2: ID de la app

column1: # context: Toast when what was typed in the send-to app row isn't a package name; %1$s is what was typed
%1$s isn't a valid app ID, so the app stays as it was.
column2: %1$s no es un ID de app válido, así que la app se queda como estaba.

column1: # context: Summary of the send-to app row with no app named
Android asks which app each time.
column2: Android pregunta qué app usar cada vez.

column1: # context: Summary of the send-to app row; %1$s is the package name
Links go to %1$s. When it isn't installed, Android asks which app.
column2: Los enlaces van a %1$s. Si no está instalada, Android pregunta qué app usar.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; Find friends from contacts is the Stories tray card that asks to upload your contacts
Hide "Find friends from contacts"
column2: Ocultar “Encontrar amigos en tus contactos”

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Hides the Stories tray card that asks to upload your contacts. Applies when Facebook next loads the tray.
column2: Oculta la tarjeta de la bandeja de historias que pide subir tus contactos. Se aplica cuando Facebook cargue la bandeja de nuevo.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; the prompts are the cards beside Create story that suggest a kind of story to make. Keep it distinct from Hide suggested stories
Hide story prompts
column2: Ocultar ideas para historias

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Share music you love is the name of one such card
Hides cards beside Create story that suggest a story to make, like Share music you love. Applies when Facebook next loads the tray.
column2: Oculta las tarjetas junto a Crear historia que sugieren una historia, como Comparte la música que te encanta. Se aplica cuando Facebook cargue la bandeja de nuevo.

column1: # context: summary of Hide "People you may know" when the build also hides tray cards; Add is the card's button
Hides friend suggestions between posts, on your own profile, and as cards with an Add button in the Stories tray.
column2: Oculta las sugerencias de amistad entre publicaciones, en tu propio perfil y como tarjetas con un botón Añadir en la bandeja de historias.

Home shows

column1: # context: %1$s is a Feeds tab filter's name, like Friends or Groups; %2$s is the Hide "Suggested for you" posts switch and %3$s the Hide Reels in the feed switch

Home asks Facebook for the posts %1$s shows in the Feeds tab. When there's nothing new there, Facebook can fill Home with suggested posts and reels, which %2$s and %3$s take out. If Facebook doesn't have that feed, Home shows All.
column2: Inicio le pide a Facebook las publicaciones que muestra %1$s en la pestaña Feeds. Cuando ahí no hay nada nuevo, Facebook puede llenar Inicio con publicaciones y reels sugeridos, que %2$s y %3$s quitan. Si Facebook no tiene ese feed, Inicio muestra Todo.

column1: # context: settings import preview; %1$s is the Following feed on Home switch, %2$s a Feeds tab filter
With %1$s on, Home will show the same posts as %2$s in the Feeds tab.
column2: Con %1$s activado, Inicio mostrará las mismas publicaciones que %2$s en la pestaña Feeds.

column2: Toca Reanudar y luego reinicia Facebook.

column1: Turn off haptics
column2: Desactivar la vibración háptica

column1: Stops the small vibrations Facebook makes when you tap or swipe. Your keyboard and phone vibrations aren't affected.
column2: Detiene las pequeñas vibraciones que hace Facebook al tocar o deslizar. Las del teclado y las del teléfono no cambian.

column1: Turn off screen transitions
column2: Desactivar las transiciones de pantalla

column1: Tabs, the Menu, photos and screens that open over Facebook appear at once instead of sliding or zooming in. Swiping between tabs still works.
column2: Las pestañas, el Menú, las fotos y las pantallas que se abren sobre Facebook aparecen al instante, sin deslizarse ni hacer zoom. Deslizar entre pestañas sigue funcionando.

column1: Unlock app icons
column2: Desbloquear íconos de la app

column1: Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus, on Facebook's App icon page. The Pick an app icon row opens that page. Your pick stays if you turn this off, so pick the blue one first to go back.
column2: Te deja elegir los íconos que Facebook reserva para Facebook Plus, en la página Ícono de la app de Facebook. La fila Elegir un ícono de la app la abre. Tu elección se mantiene si desactivas esto, así que elige primero el azul para volver.

column1: # context: settings row under Appearance, right below the Unlock app icons switch; opens Facebook's own App icon page, so use Facebook's name for that page in this language
Pick an app icon
column2: Elegir un ícono de la app

column1: Opens Facebook's App icon page, even on accounts where Facebook doesn't list it in Settings and privacy.
column2: Abre la página Ícono de la app de Facebook, incluso en cuentas donde Facebook no la muestra en Configuración y privacidad.

column1: Use the icon at the top of Home
column2: Usar el ícono en la parte superior del Inicio

column1: Shows the app icon you picked at the top of Home instead of the Facebook wordmark. Needs Unlock app icons and a pick other than the blue one. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Muestra el ícono de la app que elegiste en la parte superior del Inicio en lugar del logotipo de texto de Facebook. Necesita Desbloquear íconos de la app y una elección distinta del azul. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column1: # context: toast when the row above finds no App icon page in this Facebook build
This Facebook build has no App icon page.
column2: Esta versión de Facebook no tiene la página Ícono de la app.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; Android's own name for the floating video window
Picture-in-picture
column2: Imagen en imagen

column1: # context: summary of that switch
A playing reel or full-screen video keeps going in a small window when you leave Facebook. Android 12 or later.
column2: Un reel o un video a pantalla completa en reproducción sigue en una ventana pequeña cuando sales de Facebook. Android 12 o posterior.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; HDR is the high-contrast video and photo format some screens show brighter than everything else
Turn off HDR brightness
column2: Desactivar el brillo HDR

column1: # context: summary of that switch
HDR videos and photos stay at your screen's usual brightness instead of turning it up to full. They keep their resolution.
column2: Los vídeos y las fotos HDR se quedan en el brillo habitual de tu pantalla en lugar de subirlo al máximo. Mantienen su resolución.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback, below Turn off HDR brightness; when a video comes in both HDR and SDR, the SDR copy plays. Keep HDR and SDR as they are
Play SDR versions of HDR videos
column2: Reproducir versiones SDR de vídeos HDR

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "the same size" means the same resolution; "the switch above" is Turn off HDR brightness
When Facebook also sends an HDR video in SDR at the same size, play that version instead. The screen doesn't brighten and the picture stays as sharp. Works with the switch above on or off.
column2: Cuando Facebook también envía un vídeo HDR en SDR del mismo tamaño, se reproduce esa versión. La pantalla no se ilumina y la imagen se ve igual de nítida. Funciona con el interruptor de arriba activado o desactivado.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; it makes videos play past the silent stretches of their sound
Skip silent parts
column2: Saltar las partes en silencio

column1: # context: summary of that switch; how-tos are tutorial videos
Videos, reels and stories jump past the quiet stretches in their sound, so talks and how-tos get to the point sooner.
column2: Los vídeos, reels e historias saltan los tramos en silencio del sonido, así las charlas y los tutoriales van antes al grano.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; feed videos stay silent until the user turns their sound on
Keep feed videos muted
column2: Mantener sin sonido los vídeos del feed

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the speaker is the sound button on a video, volume up is the phone's key
Videos in your feed start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only you turn it on. Tap a video's speaker or press volume up to hear it.
column2: Los vídeos de tu feed empiezan sin sonido cada vez que abres Facebook, y solo tú lo activas. Toca el altavoz de un vídeo o pulsa la tecla de subir volumen para oírlo.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; keeps a video's progress bar (the line showing how far it has played) on screen
Keep the progress bar
column2: Mantener la barra de progreso

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a reel is a short vertical video
A reel's progress bar stays full size, ready to drag. A full-screen video's controls stay until you tap.
column2: La barra de progreso de un reel se queda a tamaño completo, lista para arrastrar. Los controles de un vídeo a pantalla completa se quedan hasta que tocas.

column1: Show a reel's time
column2: Mostrar el tiempo de un reel

column1: With Keep the progress bar on, a reel's elapsed and total time stay above the bar. Off, they show only while you drag it.
column2: Con Mantener la barra de progreso activado, el tiempo transcurrido y el total de un reel se quedan encima de la barra. Desactivado, solo se ven mientras la arrastras.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback, after Show a reel's time; a tap on the video's progress bar jumps to that point
Tap the bar to seek
column2: Tocar la barra para saltar

column1: # context: description of that switch; the dot is the bar's round handle you drag
Tap anywhere on a reel's or video's progress bar to jump there, instead of dragging the dot.
column2: Toca cualquier punto de la barra de progreso de un reel o video para saltar ahí, en vez de arrastrar el punto.

column1: # context: switch title under Marketplace; View profile is Facebook's own button on a seller's Marketplace page that opens their regular Facebook profile, so use Facebook's label for it in this language
Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
column2: Mostrar Ver perfil en los vendedores de Marketplace

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Adds a View profile button to every seller's Marketplace page, opening their Facebook profile. Facebook only shows it to some accounts.
column2: Añade un botón Ver perfil a la página de cada vendedor de Marketplace, que abre su perfil de Facebook. Facebook solo lo muestra a algunas cuentas.

column1: # context: the Save Facebook's notification sound row under Notifications and its toasts (#83)
Save Facebook's notification sound
column2: Guardar el sonido de notificación de Facebook

column1: Adds Facebook's chime to your phone's notification sounds, for categories set to None. Then pick it in Android's notification settings for Facebook, under Sound.
column2: Añade el sonido de Facebook a los sonidos de notificación del teléfono, para categorías en Ninguno. Luego elígelo en los ajustes de notificaciones de Android para Facebook, en Sonido.

column1: Saved as %1$s in the Notifications folder. Pick it under Sound in Android's notification settings for Facebook.
column2: Guardado como %1$s en la carpeta Notifications. Elígelo en Sonido, en los ajustes de notificaciones de Android para Facebook.

column1: %1$s is already in your notification sounds.
column2: %1$s ya está en tus sonidos de notificación.

column1: This build has no notification sound to save.
column2: Esta compilación no tiene ningún sonido de notificación que guardar.

column1: Couldn't save the sound. Try again.
column2: No se pudo guardar el sonido. Inténtalo de nuevo.

column1: # context: switch title on the Feed page; the composer row is the "What's on your mind?" box at the top of Home where a post starts
Hide the composer row
column2: Ocultar la fila para publicar

column1: # context: summary of that switch; use the wording Facebook itself uses in this language for "What's on your mind?" and Home
Hides the "What's on your mind?" row at the top of Home. The create button in the top bar still starts a post.
column2: Oculta la fila «¿Qué estás pensando?» en la parte superior de Inicio. El botón de crear de la barra superior sigue iniciando una publicación.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Clean mode is Facebook's own three-dot menu item on a reel or video that hides the buttons down the side, so use Facebook's name for it in this language (#75)
Always use Clean mode
column2: Usar siempre el modo limpio

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "the usual way" means Facebook's own way out of Clean mode
Opens reels and videos in Facebook's Clean mode, which hides the buttons down the side. You can still leave Clean mode as usual. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Abre los reels y vídeos en el modo limpio de Facebook, que oculta los botones del lateral. Puedes salir del modo limpio como siempre. Apagado por defecto, porque aún no se ha probado en una cuenta real.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, part of Clean up Reels; each reel plays to its end one time and stops there instead of starting over
Play reels once
column2: Reproducir los reels una vez

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "last frame" is the final picture of the video, which stays on screen

A reel stops on its last frame instead of starting over. Tap it to watch again, or swipe to the next one. Feed videos and stories aren't changed. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Un reel se detiene en su último fotograma en vez de volver a empezar. Tócalo para verlo otra vez o desliza al siguiente. Los vídeos del feed y las historias no cambian. Apagado por defecto, porque aún no se ha probado en una cuenta real.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, part of Clean up Reels; reels and videos play in the language they were recorded in instead of an audio track Facebook translated
Keep the original audio
column2: Mantener el audio original

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "dubbed" means the spoken audio was replaced by a translated voice; Meta AI is the company's AI assistant, keep the name
Reels and videos play with the sound they were made with, not a version Facebook dubbed into your language with Meta AI. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Los reels y los vídeos se reproducen con el sonido con el que se hicieron, no con una versión que Facebook dobló a tu idioma con Meta AI. Apagado por defecto, porque aún no se ha probado en una cuenta real.

column1: # context: settings section title on the App page, above the switches of Hide Meta upsells; Meta is the company
Meta's other products
column2: Otros productos de Meta

column1: # context: switch title; Edits is Meta's video editing app, keep its name
Hide Edits promotions
column2: Ocultar promociones de Edits

column1: # context: switch title; Threads is Meta's app, keep its name; cross-posting means sharing a Facebook post to Threads as well
Hide Threads cross-posting prompts
column2: Ocultar avisos para publicar también en Threads

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Threads is Meta's app, keep its name; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post, use Facebook's own word for it in this language
Hide Threads in the share sheet
column2: Ocultar Threads al compartir

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Muse is Meta's AI agent app, keep its name; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post, use Facebook's own word for it in this language
Hide Muse in the share sheet
column2: Ocultar Muse al compartir

column1: # context: switch title; Meta Verified is Meta's paid subscription, keep its name
Hide Meta Verified offers
column2: Ocultar ofertas de Meta Verified

column1: # context: switch title; avatar stickers are stickers made from your Facebook avatar
Hide avatar sticker promotions
column2: Ocultar promociones de stickers de avatar

column1: # context: summary of the Edits switch; the pill is a small button under a video in the feed that opens Edits
Hides the Edits button in the Reels composer and the Edits pill under videos. You can still make reels in Facebook.
column2: Oculta el botón Edits del creador de Reels y la etiqueta Edits bajo los vídeos. Sigues pudiendo crear reels en Facebook.

column1: # context: summary of the Threads switch; the composer is where you write a new post
Facebook stops asking whether to share your post to Threads too. Posting to Facebook works as before.
column2: Facebook deja de preguntar si quieres compartir tu publicación también en Threads. Publicar en Facebook funciona como antes.

column1: # context: summary of the Threads share sheet switch; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post
Removes the Threads button when you share something. All other ways to share stay, in the same order.
column2: Quita el botón de Threads al compartir algo. Las demás formas de compartir se quedan, en el mismo orden.

column1: # context: summary of the Muse share sheet switch; Muse is Meta's AI agent app, keep its name
Removes Muse, Meta's AI agent app, when you share something. All other ways to share stay, in the same order.
column2: Quita Muse, la app de agente de IA de Meta, al compartir algo. Las demás formas de compartir se quedan, en el mismo orden.

column1: # context: summary of the Meta Verified switch; the label is a line Facebook adds under the poster's name on some posts
No Meta Verified offer after you post, and no Meta Verified label under the names on posts. Posting works as usual.
column2: Sin la oferta de Meta Verified después de publicar y sin la etiqueta de Meta Verified debajo de los nombres en las publicaciones. Publicar funciona como siempre.

column1: # context: summary of the avatar sticker switch; promotion slots are the cards Facebook uses to suggest its own features
Hides avatar sticker promotions in comments and elsewhere, and the prompt to make an avatar. Stickers still send.
column2: Oculta las promociones de stickers de avatar en los comentarios y en otros sitios, y la invitación a crear un avatar. Los stickers se siguen enviando.

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Imagine is Meta AI's image maker, keep its name
Hide Meta AI's Imagine
column2: Ocultar Imagine de Meta AI

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name; the buttons sit under some posts
Hide other Meta AI buttons under posts
column2: Ocultar otros botones de Meta AI en las publicaciones

column1: # context: summary of the Imagine switch; Imagine me is a button Facebook puts under some posts, keep its name; Create story is Facebook's screen for making a story, use Facebook's own name for it in this language
Hides the Imagine me button on posts and the Imagine option when you write a post or create a story. Everything else works as before.
column2: Oculta el botón Imagine me en las publicaciones y la opción Imagine al escribir una publicación o crear una historia. Todo lo demás funciona como antes.

column1: # context: summary of the switch that hides the other Meta AI buttons; these are buttons Facebook puts under some posts that open Meta AI; the next button is whatever other button the post would show there
Hides the other Meta AI buttons Facebook puts under posts. The post's next button shows instead, if it has one.
column2: Oculta los demás botones de Meta AI que Facebook pone bajo las publicaciones. En su lugar aparece el siguiente botón de la publicación, si lo hay.

column1: # context: label of a switch under Stories that replays a finished story; it works together with the Stop Story auto-advance switch
Loop stories
column2: Repetir historias

column1: # context: summary of the Loop stories switch; "Stop Story auto-advance" is the label of the switch above it, so use its translation
With Stop Story auto-advance on, a finished story plays again from the start instead of waiting on its last frame. Tap or swipe to move on.
column2: Con Detener el avance automático de historias activado, una historia terminada vuelve a empezar desde el principio en lugar de quedarse en su último fotograma. Toca o desliza para avanzar.

column1: # context: label of a switch under Downloads that adds a Save photo item to the three-dot menu of posts with photos
Save photo in post menus
column2: Guardar foto en los menús de publicaciones

column1: # context: summary of the Save photo in post menus switch; "Save any photo" is the label of the switch above it and "Save photo" is the menu item, so use their translations
With Save any photo on, a post with photos gets Save photo in its three-dot menu too. A post with several saves each one, one after another.
column2: Con Guardar cualquier foto activado, una publicación con fotos también muestra Guardar foto en su menú de tres puntos. Si tiene varias, se guardan una tras otra.

column1: # context: menu item in a post's three-dot menu that saves the post's one photo to the phone
Save photo
column2: Guardar foto

column1: # context: primary save row for a Story that reshares a Reel
Save video
column2: Guardar vídeo

column1: # context: menu item in a post's three-dot menu that saves every photo of a post with several photos
Save all photos
column2: Guardar todas las fotos

column1: # context: short message shown when the photos of a post could not start saving
Couldn't save this post's photos. Try again in a moment.
column2: No se pudieron guardar las fotos de esta publicación. Vuelve a intentarlo en un momento.

column1: # context: row in a comment's long-press sheet that saves the GIF the comment holds; keep it short like Save photo
Save GIF
column2: Guardar GIF

column1: # context: message after a tap on Save GIF when the save didn't start
Couldn't save this GIF. Try again in a moment.
column2: No se pudo guardar este GIF. Vuelve a intentarlo en un momento.

column1: # context: sentence added after the summary of the Save any photo switch; Save GIF is the row's name, keep it as translated for that row
A GIF comment gets Save GIF when you long-press it.
column2: Al mantener pulsado un comentario con GIF aparece Guardar GIF.

column1: Couldn't save this story's photo. Try again in a moment.
column2: No se pudo guardar la foto de esta historia. Vuelve a intentarlo en un momento.

column1: Too many saves at once. Try again when one finishes.
column2: Hay demasiadas descargas en curso. Vuelve a intentarlo cuando termine una.

column1: # context: settings switch under Block Instant Games ads that makes a game's rewarded ad count as watched
Answer rewarded game ads as watched
column2: Dar por vistos los anuncios con recompensa de los juegos

With Block Instant Games ads on, a game's rewarded ad counts as watched. No ad plays and the game still gives its reward.

Turn off auto-translation
column2: Desactivar la traducción automática

Posts and reel captions stay in the language they were written in. Facebook's See translation link stays under them.

Keep the video speed
column2: Mantener la velocidad de los videos

The speed you pick in a feed or Watch video's menu carries over to the next videos. Reels keep their own speed. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.

Offer to download copied links
column2: Ofrecer descargar enlaces copiados

With Download feed and Watch videos on, coming back to Facebook with a reel or video link copied offers to download it, once per link. Off, Facebook doesn't look at what you copied.
column2: Con Descargar videos del feed y de Watch activado, al volver a Facebook con un enlace de un reel o un video copiado se ofrece descargarlo, una vez por enlace. Desactivado, Facebook no mira lo que copiaste.

Download the video you copied?

No thanks

column2: Abriendo el video para guardarlo

Mark as seen button

Adds an eye button to the top of each story while you view anonymously. Tap it to show up on that story's viewer list. The other stories stay hidden.

Mark as seen
column2: Marcar como vista

Marked as seen. Tap again to undo.
column2: Marcada como vista. Toca de nuevo para deshacer.

column1: # context: what TalkBack reads for the eye button once the marked story was sent as seen
Marked as seen and sent
column2: Marcada como vista y enviada

column1: # context: the word lists' dialogs, after their first paragraph: a line between slashes is a regular expression; %1$d is how many a list holds, %2$d the most characters each
A line between slashes, like /gr[ae]y/, is a pattern that can match several spellings (a regular expression). A list holds up to %1$d, each up to %2$d characters.
column2: Una línea entre barras, como /gr[ae]y/, es un patrón que puede coincidir con varias grafías (una expresión regular). Una lista admite hasta %1$d, cada uno de hasta %2$d caracteres.

column1: # context: under a word list being edited, and when its Save is refused: a line written between slashes isn't a pattern the app can read; %1$d is the line's number
Line %1$d isn't a pattern Hushfacebook can read. Fix it or remove it, then save again.
column2: La línea %1$d no es un patrón que Hushfacebook pueda leer. Corrígela o quítala y vuelve a guardar.

column1: # context: under a word list being edited, and when its Save is refused: more patterns than a list holds; %1$d is the most a list holds
A list holds up to %1$d patterns, and this one has more. Remove some, then save again.
column2: Una lista admite hasta %1$d patrones y esta tiene más. Quita algunos y vuelve a guardar.

column2: Bloquear Facebook

column1: When Facebook crashes, the error goes in a text file in Download/Hushfacebook, so you can send it with a bug report even if Facebook won't open. Links and IDs are left out. The newest five are kept.
column2: Cuando Facebook falla, el error se guarda en un archivo de texto en Download/Hushfacebook, para que puedas enviarlo con un informe de error aunque Facebook no abra. Se quitan los enlaces y los ID. Se guardan los cinco más recientes.

column1: # context: switch title in Privacy: Facebook quits fully a few seconds after you switch away from it
Close Facebook when you leave it
column2: Cerrar Facebook al salir

column1: A few seconds after you leave Facebook, it closes all the way and leaves your recent apps, so it isn't running in the background. It waits for uploads and saves to finish first. Notifications may come late, or not until you open Facebook again.
column2: Unos segundos después de salir de Facebook, se cierra por completo y desaparece de las apps recientes, así no sigue funcionando en segundo plano. Antes espera a que terminen las subidas y las descargas. Las notificaciones pueden llegar tarde o no llegar hasta que vuelvas a abrir Facebook.

column2: Las publicaciones que has visto seguirán ocultas durante %1$s.

column1: # context: settings row under Pause, backup and diagnostics that opens Facebook's own Whitehat screen; Whitehat is Facebook's name for its security researcher program, keep it
Facebook's Whitehat settings
column2: Ajustes de Whitehat de Facebook

column1: # context: summary of that row when Facebook's screen is on the phone

Facebook's own screen for security testing. It can make Facebook trust security certificates you installed, or send its data through a proxy (a go-between server). Hushfacebook doesn't change anything there.
column2: La pantalla de Facebook para pruebas de seguridad. Puede hacer que Facebook confíe en certificados de seguridad que instalaste o que envíe sus datos a través de un proxy (un servidor intermedio). Hushfacebook no cambia nada ahí.

column1: # context: summary of that row when Facebook hasn't downloaded the screen, so the row opens a web page
Facebook hasn't downloaded this screen to this phone, so a tap opens the Whitehat page on the web instead.
column2: Facebook no ha descargado esta pantalla en este teléfono, así que al tocar se abre la página de Whitehat en la web.

column1: # context: toast when the Facebook version has no such screen
This Facebook build has no Whitehat settings screen.
column2: Esta versión de Facebook no tiene la pantalla de ajustes de Whitehat.

column1: Only the first reel waits
column2: Solo espera el primer reel

column1: With the switch above on, after you play one reel, the reels you swipe to play on their own. The feed, Watch and stories always wait.
column2: Con el interruptor de arriba activado, después de reproducir un reel, los reels a los que deslizas se reproducen solos. El feed, Watch y las historias siempre esperan.

column1: Slower speeds
column2: Velocidades más lentas

column1: Adds 0.1x and 0.25x to the speed menu of reels and of feed and Watch videos, for slowing down a fast moment.
column2: Añade 0,1x y 0,25x al menú de velocidad de los reels y de los vídeos del feed y de Watch, para ralentizar un momento rápido.

column1: Speed on finished live videos
column2: Velocidad en vídeos en directo terminados

column1: A live video that has ended gets Playback speed in its gear menu, like other videos. Videos that are still live, and ads, keep Facebook's menu.
column2: Un vídeo en directo que ya terminó tiene Velocidad de reproducción en su menú de engranaje, como los demás vídeos. Los vídeos que siguen en directo y los anuncios mantienen el menú de Facebook.

column1: Share now
column2: Compartir ahora

column1: Send in Messenger
column2: Enviar por Messenger

column1: Share to your story
column2: Compartir en tu historia

column1: Share to a group
column2: Compartir en un grupo

column1: Share to a Page
column2: Compartir en una página

column1: Copy link
column2: Copiar enlace

column2: Opciones que ocultar al compartir

column1: None picked yet.
column2: Aún no has elegido nada.
