column2: Ocultas: %s

column1: Hide from the share sheet
column2: Ocultar al compartir

column1: # context: last item of the opened list of default patches a build lacks, after eight names; the count of patches not named, always 2 or more
%1$d more
column2: %1$d más

column1: # context: title of the one-time note under the status card after an update, one switch: a switch that started on in earlier versions starts off now
%1$d switch starts off now
column2: %1$d interruptor ahora empieza apagado

column1: # context: title of that note when several switches start off now
%1$d switches start off now
column2: %1$d interruptores ahora empiezan apagados

column1: # context: summary of that note while its list of switch names is closed; a tap opens it
After this update, a switch you had on may be off now. Tap to see which.
column2: Tras esta actualización, un interruptor que tenías encendido puede estar apagado. Toca para ver cuáles.

column1: # context: that note's summary once opened, one switch; the placeholder is the switch's title as the settings show it
Now off: %1$s. Turn it back on in its section if you want it. Tap again to hide this note.
column2: Ahora apagado: %1$s. Vuelve a encenderlo en su sección si lo quieres. Toca otra vez para ocultar esta nota.

column1: # context: that note's summary once opened, several switches; the placeholder is their titles joined as a list
Now off: %1$s. Turn back on the ones you want in their sections. Tap again to hide this note.
column2: Ahora apagados: %1$s. Vuelve a encender los que quieras en sus secciones. Toca otra vez para ocultar esta nota.

column1: # context: import preview and toast when a settings file empties the list picked under Share sheet items to hide
Your list of share sheet items to hide will be empty.
column2: Tu lista de opciones que ocultar al compartir quedará vacía.

column1: # context: import preview and toast, one share sheet item will be in that list after the import
Your list of share sheet items to hide will hold %1$d item.
column2: Tu lista de opciones que ocultar al compartir tendrá %1$d opción.

column1: # context: the same with several share sheet items
Your list of share sheet items to hide will hold %1$d items.
column2: Tu lista de opciones que ocultar al compartir tendrá %1$d opciones.

column1: # context: title of the last row on the settings home page; a tap opens the maintainer's Ko-fi page in a browser
Support Hushfacebook
column2: Apoya Hushfacebook

column1: # context: heading row at the end of the Privacy settings page, above a list of the places Facebook shows ads or reports usage
Where ads and tracking are blocked
column2: Dónde se bloquean los anuncios y el seguimiento

column1: # context: that heading's summary; build means this patched copy of Facebook, switch is a settings toggle
The places Facebook shows ads or reports what you do, and what this build does about each. A line with a switch takes you to it.
column2: Los sitios donde Facebook muestra anuncios o informa de lo que haces, y qué hace esta compilación en cada uno. Una línea con interruptor te lleva a él.

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads between posts in the news feed
Ads in the feed
column2: Anuncios en el feed

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads among the posts on someone's profile
Ads on profiles
column2: Anuncios en perfiles

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads between stories
Ads in Stories
column2: Anuncios en historias

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads between and inside reels
Ads in Reels
column2: Anuncios en los reels

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads among Facebook search results
Ads in search results
column2: Anuncios en los resultados de búsqueda

column1: # context: a line of that list: sponsored listings in Marketplace, a product name
Ads in Marketplace
column2: Anuncios en Marketplace

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads inside Facebook's Instant Games, a product name
Ads in Instant Games
column2: Anuncios en Instant Games

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads Facebook downloads in the background before showing them
Ads downloaded in advance
column2: Anuncios descargados por adelantado

column1: # context: a line of that list: Facebook's reports used to target ads
Ad tracking
column2: Seguimiento de anuncios

column1: # context: a line of that list: ads Facebook serves inside other apps on the phone (Audience Network)
# context: added to that line's summary: what blocking it does to those other apps; rewarded ads give a reward for watching
Those apps show their own ads or none, and their rewarded ads may fail.
column2: Esas apps muestran sus propios anuncios o ninguno, y sus anuncios con recompensa pueden fallar.

column1: # context: a line of that list: the usage statistics Facebook uploads in the background
Usage statistics uploads
column2: Envío de estadísticas de uso

column1: # context: added to that line's summary: what else holding the uploads stops, and when a change of its switch takes effect
Facebook's on-phone learning jobs stop too, and a change applies after Facebook restarts.
column2: Las tareas de aprendizaje de Facebook en el teléfono también se detienen, y un cambio se aplica cuando Facebook se reinicia.

column1: # context: a line of that list: the list of watched reels Facebook is sent
Reel watch history
column2: Historial de reels vistos

column1: # context: added to that line's summary: what not sending the history costs
Reels you've already seen may come back.
column2: Los reels que ya viste pueden volver.

column1: # context: summary of a line in that list whose patch works with no switch, from the moment the app was patched
Blocked since you patched. There's no switch for it.
column2: Bloqueado desde que parcheaste. No tiene interruptor.

column1: # context: summary of a line in that list with a switch; %1$s is the switch's name, %2$s the settings page it's on
Its switch is %1$s, in %2$s.
column2: Su interruptor es %1$s, en %2$s.

column1: # context: switch title under Links in Hushfacebook settings, next to Share sheet items to hide
Hide group buttons in the share sheet
column2: Ocultar los botones de grupo al compartir

column1: # context: that switch's summary. Send to group and Send separately are the buttons Facebook's share sheet shows when two or more people are picked
Takes away Send to group when you pick two or more people, and the share sheet's own ways to start a new group, so nothing you share makes a group chat by accident. Send separately stays.
column2: Quita “Enviar al grupo” cuando eliges a dos o más personas, y las opciones para crear un grupo nuevo al compartir, para que nada de lo que compartes cree un chat grupal por accidente. “Enviar por separado” se queda.

column1: # context: switch title under Links in Hushfacebook settings, right after Remove tracking from shared links
Share the post's own link
column2: Compartir el enlace propio de la publicación

column1: # context: that switch's summary. Copy link is the share sheet item of that name; facebook.com/share/ is a web address and stays as written
Copy link and the share sheet's other link shares give the post's own facebook.com address instead of a facebook.com/share/ link made for that one share.
column2: “Copiar enlace” y las demás formas de compartir un enlace dan la dirección de facebook.com propia de la publicación en lugar de un enlace facebook.com/share/ creado solo para esa vez.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments in Hushfacebook settings, after Hide related groups
Hide comments with shop links
column2: Ocultar comentarios con enlaces a tiendas

column1: # context: that switch's summary. Shopee, Lazada and Amazon are online shops and stay as written
Hides comments that link to a shop like Shopee, Lazada or Amazon, along with their replies.
column2: Oculta los comentarios que enlazan a una tienda como Shopee, Lazada o Amazon, junto con sus respuestas.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments, right after Hide comments with shop links
Hide comments with your words
column2: Ocultar comentarios con tus palabras

column1: # context: that switch's summary. Words to hide is the word list row under News feed and Words that keep a post its second list; use the same translations as those rows
Hides comments containing a word from your Words to hide list in News feed, along with their replies. Words that keep a post keep a comment too.
column2: Oculta los comentarios que contienen una palabra de tu lista Palabras para ocultar en Feed, junto con sus respuestas. Las palabras que mantienen una publicación también mantienen un comentario.

column1: # context: Editor limits, font selection and background action results
%1$d of %2$d people, Pages or sites. The list fills %3$d%% of its room.
column2: %1$d de %2$d personas, páginas o sitios. La lista ocupa el %3$d %% del espacio disponible.

column2: Informe de diagnóstico copiado.

column2: Último guardado

column2: No se puede guardar la línea %1$d. Revisa su longitud o usa el ID del perfil o de la página e intenta guardar de nuevo.

column1: No file chosen. Choose a .ttf or .otf font file of up to %1$d MB.
column2: No hay ningún archivo elegido. Elige un archivo de fuente .ttf u .otf de hasta %1$d MB.

column1: Removes the saved font file. Restart Facebook to use your phone's font.
column2: Elimina el archivo de fuente guardado. Reinicia Facebook para usar la fuente de tu teléfono.

column2: Elimina el archivo de fuente guardado. "Usar la fuente del sistema" seguirá desactivado.

column1: Saving diagnostic report...
column2: Guardando el informe de diagnóstico...

column1: Selected %1$s. Font changes apply after restarting Facebook.
column2: Seleccionado %1$s. Los cambios de fuente se aplican al reiniciar Facebook.

column2: Seleccionado %1$s. Reinicia Facebook para aplicar el cambio de fuente.

column1: Selected %1$s. Turn on Use the system font and restart Facebook to use it.
column2: Seleccionado %1$s. Activa "Usar la fuente del sistema" y reinicia Facebook para usarlo.

column2: Seleccionado %1$s. "Usar la fuente del sistema" está desactivado. Actívalo y reinicia Facebook para usar este archivo.

column2: No se pudo copiar el informe de diagnóstico. Inténtalo de nuevo.

column1: The list holds up to %1$d people, Pages or sites. Remove some, then save again.
column2: La lista admite hasta %1$d personas, páginas o sitios. Elimina algunos y vuelve a guardar.

column2: La foto no se guardó. Inténtalo de nuevo.

column1: The report couldn't be copied. Try again.
column2: No se pudo copiar el informe. Inténtalo de nuevo.

column1: The report couldn't be saved. Try again.
column2: No se pudo guardar el informe. Inténtalo de nuevo.

column1: The saved copy of %1$s is missing. Choose the file again.
column2: Falta la copia guardada de %1$s. Elige el archivo de nuevo.

column1: The video wasn't saved. Try again.
column2: El video no se guardó. Inténtalo de nuevo.

column1: This list needs more room than it has. Shorten it, then save again.
column2: Esta lista necesita más espacio del disponible. Acórtala y vuelve a guardar.

column1: Your settings already match that file, so nothing will change.
column2: Tus ajustes ya coinciden con ese archivo, así que no cambiará nada.

column1: # context: title of the row that restarts Facebook, shown while one change waits for a restart
Restart Facebook to apply this change
column2: Reinicia Facebook para aplicar este cambio

column1: # context: the same row with two or more changes waiting
Restart Facebook to apply %1$d changes
column2: Reinicia Facebook para aplicar %1$d cambios

column1: # context: summary of that row; after the restart the settings screen opens again on the same page
Facebook closes and reopens on this page.
column2: Facebook se cierra y se vuelve a abrir en esta página.

column1: # context: title of the row just above Support at the end of the settings home page; a tap restarts Facebook at any time
Restart Facebook
column2: Reiniciar Facebook

column1: # context: row near the end of the settings home page; opens a new bug report on GitHub
Report a problem
column2: Informar de un problema

column1: Opens a GitHub report with your versions and settings filled in. Add what happened.
column2: Abre un informe en GitHub con tus versiones y ajustes ya rellenados. Añade lo que pasó.

column1: # context: row near the top of the settings home page; a list of ready-made sets of switches
Quick setups
column2: Ajustes rápidos

column1: # context: toast after a long press hides the Quick setups row from the settings home page; the page name is the one holding the row that brings it back
# context: row on the Pause, backup and diagnostics page; shows or hides the Quick setups row on the settings home page
# context: name of a Quick setups choice that hides ads and nags; an adjective, as in a quiet feed
Quiet
column2: Tranquilo

column1: Hides ads, suggestions, promos and prompts, and stops nagging notifications.
column2: Oculta anuncios, sugerencias, promociones y avisos, y detiene las notificaciones insistentes.

column1: # context: what the Privacy choice of Quick setups turns on; camera roll scans are Hold back camera roll processing
Holds back usage reports and camera roll scans, removes link tracking, and hides your typing and screenshots.
column2: Retiene los informes de uso y los análisis del carrete, quita el seguimiento de los enlaces y oculta cuándo escribes y haces capturas.

column1: # context: name of the Quick setups choice that puts the switches back as they were after install
Back to defaults
column2: Volver a lo predeterminado

column1: # context: Lock Facebook is the name of the app lock switch, left as it is
Puts every feature switch but Lock Facebook back the way it started.
column2: Devuelve cada interruptor de función, salvo Bloquear Facebook, a como estaba al principio.

column1: # context: toast after a Quick setups choice changed one switch
Changed %1$d setting
column2: %1$d ajuste cambiado

column1: # context: the same toast for none, or for two or more
Changed %1$d settings
column2: %1$d ajustes cambiados

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: a save failed for want of a connection
The connection failed. Check your internet and try again.
column2: Falló la conexión. Revisa tu internet e inténtalo de nuevo.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the server answered a save with an error, not the file
Facebook's server didn't send the file. Try again in a moment.
column2: El servidor de Facebook no envió el archivo. Inténtalo de nuevo en un momento.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the file a save fetched came empty or cut short
The download ended before the whole file arrived. Try again.
column2: La descarga terminó antes de que llegara todo el archivo. Inténtalo de nuevo.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: a save's work file couldn't be written, for a reason the phone didn't give
Your phone couldn't write the file. Check your free space and try again.
column2: Tu teléfono no pudo escribir el archivo. Revisa el espacio libre e inténtalo de nuevo.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the phone was measured and has too little free space for a save
Not enough free space to save this. Free some up and try again.
column2: No hay espacio libre suficiente para guardar esto. Libera un poco e inténtalo de nuevo.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: a video's picture and sound couldn't be converted or joined; Download quality is the setting's name
Your phone couldn't put this video together. Try another Download quality.
column2: Tu teléfono no pudo armar este video. Prueba otra Calidad de descarga.

column1: # context: toast and Last save row: the gallery refused a finished photo or video
The file couldn't be copied into your phone's gallery. Try again in a moment.
column2: No se pudo copiar el archivo a la galería del teléfono. Inténtalo en un momento.

column1: # context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether the Hushfacebook settings shortcut shows when you hold Facebook's launcher icon
Settings shortcut on the app icon
column2: Acceso directo a la configuración en el icono

column1: # context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether a long press on the Facebook logo opens the Hushfacebook settings
Open settings from the logo
column2: Abrir la configuración desde el logotipo

column1: # context: title of a switch on the Menu settings page: whether the Hushfacebook settings row shows at the end of Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu
Settings row in Menu
column2: Fila de configuración en el menú

column1: # context: summary of the switch for the Hushfacebook settings shortcut in the launcher icon's menu
Puts Hushfacebook settings in the menu you get by holding Facebook's icon. Off, it leaves that menu.
column2: Pone la configuración de Hushfacebook en el menú que aparece al mantener pulsado el icono de Facebook. Si lo desactivas, sale de ese menú.

column1: # context: summary of the switch for opening the settings with a long press on the Facebook logo
A long press on the Facebook logo at the top of the home feed opens these settings. Off, the long press goes back to Facebook.
column2: Mantener pulsado el logotipo de Facebook, arriba en el feed de inicio, abre esta configuración. Si lo desactivas, esa pulsación vuelve a ser de Facebook.

column1: # context: summary of the switch for the Hushfacebook settings row in Facebook's Menu
Adds a Hushfacebook settings row at the end of Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu. Off, the row leaves the Menu.
column2: Añade una fila Configuración de Hushfacebook al final de Configuración y privacidad en el menú de Facebook. Si lo desactivas, la fila sale del menú.

column1: # context: summary shown instead of a switch's usual one while it is the only one of the three ways into the settings still on, so it is greyed out
The last way into these settings stays on.
column2: La última forma de llegar a esta configuración sigue activada.

column1: # context: switch title on the Appearance settings page: hides Facebook Flex's Data mode bar under the top bar; Data mode is Facebook's own name for paid mode on Flex carriers
Hide the Data mode banner
column2: Ocultar el banner del modo de datos

column1: # context: switch title on the Appearance settings page: hides Facebook Flex's purple Free mode bar; Free mode is Facebook's own name for the free text-only mode
Hide the Free mode banner
column2: Ocultar el banner del modo gratuito

column1: # context: summary of the Hide the Data mode banner switch
On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the Data mode bar under the top bar and its button to buy mobile data.
column2: En operadores con Facebook Flex, oculta la barra del modo de datos bajo la barra superior y su botón para comprar datos móviles.

column1: # context: summary of the Hide the Free mode banner switch; the purple bar is also where you switch back to Data mode
On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the purple Free mode bar. That bar is also how you go back to Data mode, so turn this off when you want to switch.
column2: En operadores con Facebook Flex, oculta la barra morada del modo gratuito. Esa barra también es la forma de volver al modo de datos, así que desactiva esto cuando quieras cambiar.

column1: # context: switch title under Picture-in-picture on the Playback page: the small window opens only from the Picture-in-picture row this adds to a reel's three-dot More menu, not when you leave Facebook
Only from a reel's More menu
column2: Solo desde el menú de un reel

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Picture-in-picture is the name of the row in the reel's menu, translated as the row is; the three dots are the reel's own menu button
Leaving Facebook doesn't open the window. Tap Picture-in-picture in a reel's More menu (the three dots) when you want one. That row shows on upright reels, not wide ones.
column2: Salir de Facebook no abre la ventana. Toca Imagen en imagen en el menú de un reel (los tres puntos) cuando quieras una. Esa opción aparece en los reels verticales, no en los horizontales.

column1: # context: switch title under Picture-in-picture on the Playback page; the button floats over a reel or video and opens the small window when tapped
Picture-in-picture button
column2: Botón de imagen en imagen

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "the window" is the small picture-in-picture window
Shows a small button at the left edge of a reel or video that has the window ready. Tap it to open the window right away. Works with Picture-in-picture on.
column2: Muestra un botón pequeño en el borde izquierdo de un reel o vídeo que tiene la ventana lista. Tócalo para abrir la ventana al instante. Funciona con Imagen en imagen activado.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; it makes videos you post to your own Story ask for high quality when they upload
Upload Stories in HD
column2: Subir historias en HD

column1: # context: summary of that switch; standard is the normal upload quality, high the better one
Videos you post to your Story ask Facebook for its high upload quality instead of standard. Applies to the next Story you post.
column2: Los videos que publicas en tu historia piden a Facebook su calidad de subida alta en lugar de la estándar. Se aplica a la próxima historia que publiques.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; a photo story is a still picture posted to your own Story, and a song added to it plays while the picture shows
Longer music on photo stories
column2: Música más larga en historias con foto

column1: # context: summary of that switch; 15 seconds is how long Facebook lets the song on a photo play, and the song's length can be shorter than 30
A song you add to a photo for your Story plays for up to 30 seconds instead of 15. Applies to the next song you pick.
column2: La canción que añades a una foto para tu historia suena hasta 30 segundos en lugar de 15. Se aplica a la próxima canción que elijas.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; two fingers spread apart on a story or a profile photo make it bigger
Pinch to zoom
column2: Pellizcar para hacer zoom

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "let go" means lifting your fingers off the screen
Pinch a story or a photo on someone's profile to zoom in. It goes back when you let go.
column2: Pellizca una historia o una foto en el perfil de alguien para acercarla. Vuelve a su tamaño cuando sueltas.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories, right below Pinch to zoom; the zoomed picture stays zoomed after the fingers lift
Stay zoomed
column2: Mantener el zoom

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "Pinch to zoom" is the label of the switch above it, so use its translation; "Back" is the phone's Back button
With Pinch to zoom on, the photo or story stays zoomed when you let go, and a story stays paused. Drag with one finger or pinch again. Tap or press Back when you're done.
column2: Con Pellizcar para hacer zoom activado, la foto o la historia se queda ampliada cuando sueltas, y la historia se queda en pausa. Muévela con un dedo o vuelve a pellizcar. Toca o pulsa Atrás cuando termines.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories, right below Stay zoomed; two quick taps on a photo zoom it in where you tapped
Double tap to zoom
column2: Tocar dos veces para hacer zoom

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "Pinch to zoom" is the label of the switch two rows above it, so use its translation; a story is the full-screen picture or video someone shares for a day
With Pinch to zoom on, double tap a photo on a profile to zoom in where you tapped, and double tap again to put it back. A single tap still opens the photo, a moment later.
column2: Con Pellizcar para hacer zoom activado, toca dos veces una foto de un perfil para ampliar donde tocaste, y toca dos veces otra vez para devolverla. Un solo toque sigue abriendo la foto, un momento después.

column1: No ads downloaded in advance
column2: Sin anuncios descargados por adelantado

column1: No ad tracking
column2: Sin seguimiento de anuncios

column1: No Facebook ads in other apps
column2: Sin anuncios de Facebook en otras apps

column1: Facebook ads in other apps
column2: Anuncios de Facebook en otras apps

column1: Part of the Reels ad blocking

column2: Quita el botón de Messenger de la barra superior, y los botones de al lado se juntan para cerrar el hueco. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance; the count is the unread number badge on the Messenger icon

Keeps the Messenger button but drops the unread count on it.
column2: Mantiene el botón de Messenger, pero quita el número de mensajes sin leer que aparece en él.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance; the logo is the Facebook wordmark or icon at the left of the top bar
Hide the Facebook logo

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Hushfacebook is the app's name and stays as it is; press and hold is a long press

column2: Oculta el logotipo de Facebook en la barra superior. El hueco tiene el mismo tamaño y, al mantenerlo pulsado, sigue abriendo los ajustes de Hushfacebook. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column1: Hide the search button

column2: Quita los números de los botones Me gusta, Comentar y Compartir debajo de las publicaciones, así cada uno muestra solo su palabra. Los botones se quedan donde están. Un cambio se ve en las publicaciones que se carguen después.

Hide counts on reels
column2: Ocultar los números en los reels

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Like, Comment and Share are Facebook's own button labels, so use Facebook's wording in your language
Takes the numbers away from under a reel's Like, Comment and Share icons. The icons stay where they are. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: Quita los números debajo de los iconos Me gusta, Comentar y Compartir de un reel. Los iconos se quedan donde están. Un cambio se ve a partir del siguiente reel.

Takes the Save button off the side of reels. The buttons above it move down. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: Quita el botón Guardar del lateral de los reels. Los botones de encima bajan. Un cambio se ve a partir del siguiente reel.

Takes the speaker button off the bottom of the side of reels. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: Quita el botón del altavoz de la parte inferior del lateral de los reels. Un cambio se ve a partir del siguiente reel.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the reaction preview is the stack of reaction icons and the line with the number of reactions under a post
Hide the reaction preview on posts
column2: Ocultar la vista previa de reacciones en las publicaciones

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "reactions" are Facebook's Like, Love, Haha and other reactions

Hides the stacked reaction icons and the reactions count under posts. The space stays, so a tap where they were still opens the list of reactions. To take the number off the Like button too, turn on Hide counts on posts.
column2: Oculta los iconos de reacciones apilados y el número de reacciones bajo las publicaciones. El espacio se mantiene, así que tocar donde estaban sigue abriendo la lista de reacciones. Para quitar también el número del botón Me gusta, activa Ocultar los números en las publicaciones.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; the reaction preview is the stack of reaction icons in the corner of a comment

column2: Ocultar la vista previa de reacciones en los comentarios

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "reactions" are Facebook's Like, Love, Haha and other reactions
Hides the stacked reaction icons in the corner of a comment. The space stays, so a tap where they were still opens the list of reactions.
column2: Oculta los iconos de reacciones apilados en la esquina de un comentario. El espacio se mantiene, así que tocar donde estaban sigue abriendo la lista de reacciones.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; "Download" is the post menu row "Download to phone" and "post menus" are the three-dot menus under posts
Download first in post menus
column2: Descargar primero en los menús de publicaciones

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "Download to phone" and "Save photo" are the menu rows, translate them as elsewhere; "More options" is the title of Facebook's own page, use Facebook's wording

Moves Download to phone and Save photo from the end of a post's three-dot menu to the start of its options list. Facebook's own top rows stay above them (on photo posts the list is the More options page). A post with nothing to save gets neither.
column2: Mueve Descargar en el teléfono y Guardar foto del final del menú de tres puntos de una publicación al principio de su lista de opciones. Las filas superiores de Facebook se quedan encima (en las publicaciones con fotos, la lista es la página Más opciones). Una publicación sin nada que guardar no recibe ninguno.

Long press opens comments

column1: # context: summary of the double tap switch
A double tap on a reel opens its comments instead of liking it. Turn off double tap to like still wins when it's on. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Tocar dos veces un reel abre sus comentarios en lugar de darle Me gusta. Si «Desactivar tocar dos veces para dar Me gusta» está activado, ese ajuste tiene prioridad. Desactivado por defecto, porque aún no se ha probado con una cuenta real.

column1: # context: summary of the long press switch

Holding a reel opens its comments instead of Facebook's long-press menu or the 2x hold. The reel's more button still opens that menu. Holding a feed post's photo or the line with its name opens that post's comments, and holding its text or a profile picture works as before. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Mantener pulsado un reel abre sus comentarios en lugar del menú de pulsación larga de Facebook o del 2x al mantener. El botón de más opciones del reel sigue abriendo ese menú. Mantener pulsada la foto de una publicación del feed o la línea con su nombre abre los comentarios de esa publicación, y mantener pulsado su texto o una foto de perfil funciona como antes. Desactivado por defecto, porque aún no se ha probado con una cuenta real.

Open videos in another app
column2: Abrir videos en otra app

Adds Open in another app to feed and Watch video menus. It hands the video to a player or casting app, such as VLC or Web Video Caster. A video with no single file to hand over says so.
column2: Añade «Abrir en otra app» a los menús de los videos del feed y de Watch. Pasa el video a una app de reproducción o de transmisión, como VLC o Web Video Caster. Si un video no tiene un solo archivo que pasar, lo avisa.

Keeps a list on this phone of the reels, videos and stories you watch, so you can find one again after the feed refreshes. Nothing leaves your phone.

Open comments at full height

Comments open on a sheet that fills the screen instead of stopping part way up. On reels and videos, Comment opens that sheet in place of the split view with the video on top.
column2: Los comentarios se abren en una hoja que ocupa toda la pantalla en lugar de quedarse a media altura. En reels y videos, Comentar abre esa hoja en lugar de la vista dividida con el video arriba.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance; on, Android's status bar (clock, battery) is hidden on Facebook's main screen
Hide the status bar
column2: Ocultar la barra de estado

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a swipe down from the top edge shows the bar briefly
Takes the phone's status bar, with the time and battery, off Facebook's main screen, so the app gets the whole screen. Swipe down from the top edge to see it for a moment.
column2: Quita la barra de estado del teléfono, con la hora y la batería, de la pantalla principal de Facebook, para que la app ocupe toda la pantalla. Desliza hacia abajo desde el borde superior para verla un momento.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; on, a video tapped in the news feed opens alone in the full-screen player instead of leading into endless reels
Open feed videos on their own
column2: Abrir los videos del feed por separado

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the Reels tab itself still scrolls normally
A video you tap in the feed opens full screen by itself, with no reels to swipe to after it. The Reels tab keeps scrolling. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Un video que tocas en el feed se abre solo en pantalla completa, sin reels a los que deslizar después. La pestaña Reels sigue funcionando igual. Desactivado por defecto, ya que aún no se ha probado con una cuenta real.

Hide For you in search
column2: Ocultar Para ti en la búsqueda

column1: # context: summary of that switch; recent searches are the user's own past searches, and the suggestions as you type are the ones under the search box while typing
Hides the For you searches Facebook suggests when you open search. Your recent searches and the suggestions as you type stay.
column2: Oculta las búsquedas de Para ti que Facebook sugiere al abrir la búsqueda. Tus búsquedas recientes y las sugerencias mientras escribes se mantienen.

column1: # context: switch title under Search; People you may know is Facebook's row of friend suggestions on the search screen before anything is typed, as in Hide "People you may know"
Hide "People you may know" in search

column2: Oculta la fila de Personas que quizá conozcas que Facebook muestra al abrir la búsqueda. Tus búsquedas recientes y las sugerencias mientras escribes se mantienen.

column1: # context: switch title under Search; on, what the user searches for isn't added to their Facebook search history
Don't save search history
column2: No guardar el historial de búsqueda

column1: # context: summary of that switch; searches already in the history are the user's own past searches, which stay until the user deletes them
What you search for, and the pages and profiles you open from a search, aren't added to your Facebook search history. Searches already there stay until you delete them.

Search date range

Hide the audio line on reels

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "Original audio" is Facebook's own label, so use the wording Facebook shows in this language
Takes the line with the reel's sound, "Original audio" or a song, off the bottom of reels. Other info stays. A change shows from the next reel.
column2: Quita de la parte inferior de los reels la línea con el sonido del reel, «Audio original» o una canción. El resto de la información se queda. Un cambio se ve a partir del siguiente reel.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the message is Facebook's own "This is taking a while. Try checking your network connection." that pops up while a video or GIF loads slowly
Hide the slow connection message
column2: Ocultar el aviso de conexión lenta

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "This is taking a while" is Facebook's own message, so use the wording Facebook shows in this language
Stops the "This is taking a while" message about your network connection when a video or GIF is slow to load. It keeps loading as before.
column2: Quita el mensaje «Esto está tardando un poco» sobre tu conexión de red cuando un video o GIF tarda en cargar. Sigue cargando como siempre.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the Reels row is the strip of reel tiles Facebook shows between posts in the news feed, each tile playing a short clip of its reel over and over
Play whole reels in the feed's Reels row
column2: Reproducir reels completos en la fila de Reels del feed

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a tile is one reel's box in that row
The reels in your feed's Reels row play from the start and keep going, instead of repeating a second or two. Tiles drawn after a change pick it up.
column2: Los reels de la fila de Reels de tu feed se reproducen desde el principio y siguen, en lugar de repetir uno o dos segundos. Los recuadros que aparecen después de un cambio ya lo aplican.

column1: # context: title of the row on the Appearance page, with AMOLED in the build, that takes a color code for dark mode's backgrounds; also its dialog's title
Background color
column2: Color de fondo

column1: # context: text in that row's dialog above the field; %1$s is the lightest gray code it takes, %2$s the color code the patch wrote, both like #0D1117; keep #RRGGBB and #0D1117 as they are
A color code (#RRGGBB) for dark mode's backgrounds, like #0D1117. Grays up to about %1$s work. Leave it blank for %2$s, the color Hushfacebook was patched with.
column2: Un código de color (#RRGGBB) para los fondos del modo oscuro, como #0D1117. Funcionan los grises hasta aproximadamente %1$s. Déjalo vacío para usar %2$s, el color con el que se parcheó Hushfacebook.

column1: # context: summary of that row while it's blank; %1$s is the color code the patch wrote, like #0D1117
Uses %1$s, the color Hushfacebook was patched with. Type a color code to change it.
column2: Usa %1$s, el color con el que se parcheó Hushfacebook. Escribe un código de color para cambiarlo.

column1: # context: summary of that row with a color saved; %1$s is that color code, like #0D1117
Dark mode's backgrounds use %1$s. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Los fondos del modo oscuro usan %1$s. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with text that isn't a color code; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #0D1117 as they are
%1$s isn't a color. Type a six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #0D1117, or leave it blank for the color Hushfacebook was patched with.
column2: “%1$s” no es un color. Escribe un código de color de seis dígitos (#RRGGBB), como #0D1117, o déjalo vacío para usar el color con el que se parcheó Hushfacebook.

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with an eight-digit code that isn't fully opaque; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #0D1117 as they are
%1$s is see-through. Type a solid six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #0D1117.
column2: %1$s es transparente. Escribe un código de color sólido de seis dígitos (#RRGGBB), como #0D1117.

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with a color too light for Facebook's white text; %1$s is what was typed, %2$s the lightest gray code it takes
%1$s is too light for Facebook's text to stay readable. Pick a darker color. Grays up to about %2$s work.
column2: %1$s es demasiado claro para que el texto de Facebook siga siendo legible. Elige un color más oscuro. Funcionan los grises hasta aproximadamente %2$s.

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets AMOLED's Background color row back to blank; "AMOLED black theme" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes the AMOLED black theme, dark mode's backgrounds will be the color it was patched with.
column2: Si tu Facebook parcheado incluye el tema negro AMOLED, los fondos del modo oscuro serán del color con el que se parcheó.

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets AMOLED's Background color row; %1$s is a color code like #0D1117; "AMOLED black theme" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes the AMOLED black theme, dark mode's backgrounds will be %1$s.
column2: Si tu Facebook parcheado incluye el tema negro AMOLED, los fondos del modo oscuro serán %1$s.

Light background color
column2: Color de fondo claro

A color code (#RRGGBB) for light mode's backgrounds in place of white, like #FFF8E7. Grays down to about %1$s work, and text gets darker where it needs to. Leave it blank for Facebook's own white.

column1: # context: summary of that row while it's blank, so Facebook's light mode keeps its own white backgrounds
Uses Facebook's own white. Type a color code to change it.
column2: Usa el blanco de Facebook. Escribe un código de color para cambiarlo.

column1: # context: summary of that row once a color is saved; %1$s is the color code
Light mode's backgrounds use %1$s. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Los fondos del modo claro usan %1$s. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with text that isn't a color code; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #FFF8E7 as they are
%1$s isn't a color. Type a six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #FFF8E7, or leave it blank for Facebook's own white.
column2: “%1$s” no es un color. Escribe un código de color de seis dígitos (#RRGGBB), como #FFF8E7, o déjalo vacío para usar el blanco de Facebook.

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with an eight-digit code that isn't fully opaque; %1$s is what was typed; keep #RRGGBB and #FFF8E7 as they are
%1$s is see-through. Type a solid six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #FFF8E7.
column2: %1$s es transparente. Escribe un código de color sólido de seis dígitos (#RRGGBB), como #FFF8E7.

column1: # context: shown when Save is tapped on that row with a color too dark for light mode's dark text; %1$s is what was typed, %2$s a gray color code like #A6A6A6
%1$s is too dark for Facebook's light mode text to stay readable. Pick a lighter color. Grays down to about %2$s work.
column2: %1$s es demasiado oscuro para que el texto del modo claro de Facebook siga siendo legible. Elige un color más claro. Funcionan los grises hasta aproximadamente %2$s.

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets AMOLED's Light background color row back to blank; "AMOLED black theme" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes the AMOLED black theme, light mode's backgrounds will be Facebook's own white.
column2: Si tu Facebook parcheado incluye el tema negro AMOLED, los fondos del modo claro usarán el blanco de Facebook.

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets AMOLED's Light background color row; %1$s is a color code like #FFF8E7; "AMOLED black theme" is the patch's name, keep it as translated for that patch
If your patched Facebook includes the AMOLED black theme, light mode's backgrounds will be %1$s.
column2: Si tu Facebook parcheado incluye el tema negro AMOLED, los fondos del modo claro serán %1$s.

Hide "Related posts" under posts
column2: Ocultar «Publicaciones relacionadas» debajo de las publicaciones

Hides the "Related posts" list Facebook adds under some posts, with its titles written by Meta AI. The post and its comments stay.

Home header text

column1: # context: summary of that row while it's blank
Facebook's logo stays at the top of Home. Type your own words to show them there.
column2: El logo de Facebook se queda en la parte superior de Inicio. Escribe tus propias palabras para mostrarlas ahí.

column1: # context: summary of that row; %1$s is the saved words
The top of Home says %1$s. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: La parte superior de Inicio dice %1$s. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column1: # context: import preview sentence: the file sets the Home header text row back to blank
The top of Home will show Facebook's own logo.
column2: La parte superior de Inicio mostrará el logo propio de Facebook.

Home header picture

Remove the header picture
column2: Quitar la imagen del encabezado

Puts your words or Facebook's logo back at the top of Home. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Vuelve a poner tus palabras o el logo de Facebook en la parte superior de Inicio. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column1: # context: summary under Home header picture when nothing is picked
No picture chosen. Choose one to show at the top of Home instead of Facebook's logo.
column2: No hay ninguna imagen elegida. Elige una para mostrarla en la parte superior de Inicio en lugar del logo de Facebook.

column1: # context: summary under Home header picture; %1$s is the picked file's name
The saved copy of %1$s is missing. Choose the picture again.
column2: Falta la copia guardada de %1$s. Elige la imagen de nuevo.

column1: # context: summary under Home header picture; %1$s is the picked file's name
Selected %1$s. It shows at the top of Home in place of your words and Facebook's logo.
column2: Seleccionado %1$s. Se muestra en la parte superior de Inicio en lugar de tus palabras y del logo de Facebook.

column1: # context: summary under Home header picture while the picked picture is copied
Copying the picture
column2: Copiando la imagen

column1: # context: toast after a picture is picked; %1$s is the picked file's name
Selected %1$s. Restart Facebook to see it at the top of Home.
column2: Seleccionado %1$s. Reinicia Facebook para verlo en la parte superior de Inicio.

column1: # context: toast when the picked file isn't a picture
That isn't a picture Android can open. The top of Home didn't change.
column2: Eso no es una imagen que Android pueda abrir. La parte superior de Inicio no cambió.

column1: # context: toast when the picked picture is too large; %1$d is the limit in megabytes
That picture is over %1$d MB. The top of Home didn't change.
column2: Esa imagen pesa más de %1$d MB. La parte superior de Inicio no cambió.

column1: # context: toast when the picture's copy can't be written
Couldn't save a copy of that picture. Check that the phone has room, then try again.
column2: No se pudo guardar una copia de esa imagen. Comprueba que el teléfono tenga espacio y vuelve a intentarlo.

column1: # context: toast when the picked file can't be read
Couldn't open that file. The top of Home didn't change.
column2: No se pudo abrir ese archivo. La parte superior de Inicio no cambió.

column1: # context: toast after Remove the header picture
Header picture removed. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Imagen del encabezado quitada. Reinicia Facebook para ver el cambio.

column1: # context: toast when Remove the header picture couldn't save
Couldn't remove the header picture. Try again.
column2: No se pudo quitar la imagen del encabezado. Inténtalo de nuevo.

column1: # context: toast when the app holding the picked picture stalls
The app holding that picture is taking too long, so Hushfacebook stopped waiting. The top of Home didn't change.
column2: La app que guarda esa imagen tarda demasiado, así que Hushfacebook dejó de esperar. La parte superior de Inicio no cambió.

column1: # context: toast when a tap on Home header picture comes while the last stalled app still holds a worker
The app holding the last picture still hasn't answered. Try again later.
column2: La app de la última imagen aún no ha respondido. Inténtalo más tarde.

column1: Video stories don't start by themselves. Touch and hold a story, then let go, to play it. Works with Tap to play on or off.
column2: Las historias de vídeo no empiezan solas. Mantén pulsada una historia y luego suéltala para reproducirla. Funciona con «Toca para reproducir» activado o desactivado.

column2: Más vistos en Reels del perfil

column1: A profile's Reels tab lists its most viewed reels first instead of the newest. Off keeps Facebook's order. Only the reels the tab has loaded are sorted, and a reel with no view count stays after the rest.
column2: La pestaña Reels de un perfil muestra primero los reels más vistos en lugar de los más nuevos. Desactivado mantiene el orden de Facebook. Solo se ordenan los reels que la pestaña ya cargó, y un reel sin número de vistas queda después del resto.

column1: Not in this build, so dark mode stays Facebook's dark gray. Morphe Manager doesn't pick it by default. Turn on Expert mode in Manager, choose the %1$s patch and patch again.
column2: No está en esta compilación, así que el modo oscuro sigue con el gris oscuro de Facebook. Morphe Manager no lo elige por defecto. Activa el modo experto en Manager, elige el parche %1$s y vuelve a parchear.

column1: Cast button on reels
column2: Botón de enviar en reels

column1: Adds a cast button to reels, under Download. It hands the reel to a casting app you have, such as Web Video Caster, which sends it to your TV.
column2: Añade un botón de enviar a los reels, debajo de Descargar. Pasa el reel a una app de transmisión que tengas, como Web Video Caster, que lo envía a tu TV.
